text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Diplomatic efforts aim at containing the deteriorating situation in south Lebanon.
- Spain and Lebanon announce a financial agreement and a letter of understanding which includes a $105 million loan.
- Lebanon's ceasefire monitoring group: Israel breaches the terms of the April 1996 understanding which ended Israel's military aggression on Lebanon that month.
- U.S. Secretary of State Albright carefully reviews the issue of the ban imposed on U.S. citizens wishing to travel to Lebanon.
- Katyusha rocket fired by the resistance hits the Galilee region in northern Israel.
- Head of the Brazilian parliament to visit Beirut this month.
- French President Chirac suggests to the Americans a new fomula...A multinational force in south Lebanon and the Golan Heights in Syria.
- Lebanese athletes win 11 medals in the Pan Arab Games in Beirut.
